title: Generalized Frobenius Partitions Modulo Powers of $2$
summary: Let $cφ_k(n)$ denote the number of $k$-colored generalized Frobenius partitions of $n$. We prove that, for every $m\geq2$ and every $k\equiv2\pmod{2^m}$, \[ \sum_{n\geq0}cφ_k(n)q^n\equiv\frac{\varphi(q)\,(q^2;q^2)_\infty}{(q;q)_\infty^2}\sum_{n\geq0}cφ_{k/2}(n)q^{2n}\pmod{2^m}, \] where $\varphi(q)$ is the classical theta function. For $m=2$ this recovers a congruence of Chan, Wang, and Yang. Applied with $k=18$, we determine $cφ_{18}(2n+1)$ modulo $16$ completely.
